description.value: Table: Summon Monster IV Creature Subtype(s) Bennu* (Avian, Fire, [holy/shadow]) Black Shark* (Aquatic [holy/shadow]) Black Widow* [(holy/shadow)] Boundfat (Daemon, Evil, Extraplanar) Elemental (Medium) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Desertpede* [(holy/shadow)] Garchimacera (Devil, Evil, Extraplanar, Lawful) Murussu* [(holy/shadow)] Sabertusk* [(holy/shadow)] Stunner* [(holy/shadow)] This spell functions like Summon Monster I , except that you can summon one creature from the 4th-level list with a CR rating of 4 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 3rd-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 2nd-level or lower lists.
